title: 농장 불량 및 부서별 피드백 추적
qualityIdentity: CaseKey; source DeductionKey; farm+product+symptom, year. Customer identity is not returned.

actions.name: QUALITY_READ
actions.sideEffect: 기존 확정 불량 원장과 같은 연도 ViewWarehouse 입고를 읽기 전용으로 대조해 농장별 대차수 불량률과 차수별 품목 이슈 후보를 표시한다. 분석 반영 그룹 수와 제외 행 수를 함께 안내하고 피드백 이벤트가 0건이어도 분석 원본은 숨기지 않는다.

actions.name: QUALITY_EVENT
actions.sideEffect: 사용자가 이슈로 처리 또는 이력 저장을 명시적으로 눌렀을 때만 WebFarmQualityCase와 WebFarmQualityEvent를 기록한다.

criteria.source: confirmed active WebSalesDefectDeduction, original parent week, Quantity/OriginalQuantity; denominator is same-year ViewWarehouse OutQuantity by parent week, normalized FarmName, ProdKey and Product.OutUnit; no financial status filter
criteria.units: rates require exact original output unit; no box/bunch/stem conversion; missing or zero incoming denominator is shown as unknown, never 0 percent
criteria.rate: farm trend numerator is all confirmed defects for farm+unit+parent week and denominator is all ViewWarehouse incoming products for the same farm+unit+parent week; item candidate denominator additionally requires exact ProdKey
criteria.state: COMMENT preserves status; REQUEST creates unanswered round; RESPONSE only incoming/admin; APPLY requires answered; CLOSE manual; recurrence is suspected until reviewed
criteria.storage: WebFarmQualityCase+WebFarmQualityEvent only; immutable events, optimistic version and request idempotency
criteria.downstream: Estimate, Order, Shipment, Warehouse, Stock, WebProfitReport preserved

crossYearFixture.description: 2025 and 2026 same parent week are isolated
